The Mad Mage summoned more monsters than he could control, and his room, beneath the Ancient Temple of Thais, filled up with creatures. You get the key to the room from {npc:A Prisoner} in Mintwallin (solving a riddle and giving him apples), clear the room and open the chests with the {item:Hat of the Mad}, the {item:Stone Skin Amulet} and the {item:Star Amulet}.
